description.zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: Application ID. Get it from the console. Pass one ID only.
Token required to join the meeting. For sample code, see the referenced document.

description.zh: pstn场景下自定义线路号码。
description.en: Custom line number for PSTN calls.
Channel ID. Pass one ID only.

description.zh:
呼叫第三方sip的设备类型：
- sip_device
- mcu
- phone

备注：当前阶段，仅支持phone类型
description.en:
Device type of the third-party SIP system:

- sip\_device

- mcu

- phone

Note: Only phone is supported at this time.

description.zh: 第三方会议系统是否要注册呼入。
description.en: Whether the third-party conferencing system must register before receiving the call.

description.zh:
1. 就近接入 rtc sip 服务器IP地址。
2. 用户通过本地进行解析域名:rtcsip.dingtalk.com获取到就近接入地址。
如: dig rtcsip.dingtalk.com获取
description.en:
1. IP address of the nearest RTC SIP server.

2. Resolve the domain name rtcsip.dingtalk.com locally to get the nearest address. For example, run dig rtcsip.dingtalk.com.
Name displayed for the user on the third-party system.

description.zh:
1. 当设备是mcu时，表示呼入的第三方会议系统的频道号码
2. 当设备是sip_device时，表示要邀请的注册设备的注册号码
3. 当设备是phone时，表示被叫的电话号码
description.en:
1. If the device is an MCU, this is the channel number of the third-party conferencing system.

2. If the device is a SIP device, this is the registration number of the device to invite.

3. If the device is a phone, this is the called phone number.

description.zh:
1. 当设备是mcu 表示第三方会议系统的地址信息ip:port;transport=tcp/udp/tls
如："30.240.160.66:5060;transport=tcp"
2. 当设备是sip_device 表示要邀请的注册设备的注册地址
如: 39.101.232.13
3. 当设备是phone 表示电话网关的地址信息
如："30.240.160.66:5060;transport=tcp"
description.en:
1. If the device is an MCU, this is the IP address and port of the third-party conferencing system in the format ip:port;transport=tcp/udp/tls. Example: 30.240.160.66:5060;transport=tcp.

2. If the device is a SIP device, this is the registration address of the device to invite. Example: 39.101.232.13.

3. If the device is a phone, this is the address of the PSTN gateway. Example: 30.240.160.66:5060;transport=tcp.

description.zh: 呼叫第三方sip的品牌型号 如polycom/cisco/tencent/zoom/pstn
description.en: Brand or model of the third-party SIP device. Examples: polycom, cisco, tencent, zoom, pstn.

description.zh:
1. 当DeviceType = mcu ，代表第三方会议系统
2. 当DeviceType = sip_device  代表注册设备
3. 如果第三方会议系统要求注册呼入，则为第三方系统提供的注册账号
4. 如果不需要注册呼叫，则为呼入第三方的sip用户名rtc userid
description.en:
1. If DeviceType is mcu, this is the third-party conferencing system.

2. If DeviceType is sip\_device, this is the registered device.

3. If the third-party system requires registration, use the account provided by that system.

4. If no registration is required, use the SIP username (RTC user ID).

description.zh: 如果第三方要注册呼入，匹配SipUserId的注册密码。
description.en: The registration password for the SipUserId. This parameter is required when a third party registers to receive incoming calls.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

The per-user QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your business. Call this operation only as needed.
